coverage: Whole group totals; no product-level profit allocation
incomeDefinition: Interest earned plus other income, including insurance premium and other operating income from insurance businesses. This is gross group income before interest expense, insurance claims, operating expenses and provisions; it is not sales or net interest income.
definition: Consolidated net profit after tax, share of associates where applicable, and deduction of profit attributable to minority shareholders. Minority shareholders own stakes in group subsidiaries; their earnings are excluded from this profit figure.
location: PDF page 11 · consolidated annual results, year ended 31 March 2026 column, rows 1–3 and 12–16
notes: Group totals include the bank and consolidated subsidiaries, including insurance operations. Total group PAT before minority interest is ₹79,219.46 crore; ₹3,193.49 crore belongs to minority shareholders. Product categories such as home loans and cards are not assigned individual profits here. A PAT-to-total-income ratio is not a manufacturing or retail operating margin.
insight: The group earns income from lending, investments, fees and insurance. To investigate the bank itself, separately inspect standalone net interest income, funding costs and loan-loss provisions; group gross income alone cannot show whether lending quality improved.
